# Ahmed Nasser — Frontend Developer

## Skills

- Core: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript
- Secondary: Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, REST, WebSockets, Vitest, Playwright
- Interface: Figma to code, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), i18next and RTL
- Components: Next.js App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, SSR, SSG, ISR, design systems, clean architecture
- Data: TanStack Query, WebSockets, Pusher, React Hook Form + Zod, RBAC
- Security: XSS and CSRF prevention, Content Security Policy, input validation, dependency audits
- Performance: Core Web Vitals, code splitting, lazy loading, re-render optimization, technical SEO, GEO, AIO
- AI & quality: Claude Code, OpenCode, AI coding agents, Vitest, Playwright, GitLab CI/CD

## Experience

- E2E County (Jan 2026 – Present, on-site, Cairo): sole frontend developer on Cyber-Guardian, a threat-intelligence SaaS (RBAC, advanced data tables, breach-trend analytics); TravWare ERP interfaces used in production by travel clients, plus a flights & hotels booking engine.
- INCode (Feb 2024 – Dec 2025, hybrid, Cairo): sole frontend developer owning production releases, change requests and hotfixes; dashboards for Olimi.ai (Voice AI, first client Paymob) and Beesly AI; built Elli, an enterprise school platform, in about 6 months; led two junior developers.
- Mazeed (Apr 2022 – Feb 2024, remote): migrated legacy HTML, Bootstrap and jQuery products to React for Saudi clients including Monsha'at and Takaful; optimized Core Web Vitals across all platforms.
- Freelance (part-time, by referral): Ajzaa marketplace dashboard, Baian AI invoice extraction, Rayan Hajj water distribution platform, tourism platforms with Next.js SSR.
